results.action: org.wikipedia.dev is already launched by the runner or by setup; do not use launcher search or intents. If onboarding appears, tap Forward until Skip is available, then tap Skip. From the main feed, tap the bottom Search tab (nav_tab_search), then tap search_card to open SearchActivity.
results.comment: The app was already on the main feed. The Search tab opened, search_card was visible, and tapping it opened SearchActivity.

results.action: Tap search_src_text, type sentinel text 'zznavbackqx', and confirm search_src_text shows it. Press system Back once to hide the soft keyboard while staying in SearchActivity. Then press system Back a second time; this is the navigation Back and should return to the Search tab where search_card is visible.
commands: adb -s emulator-5554 shell input keyevent KEYCODE_BACK
adb -s emulator-5554 shell input keyevent KEYCODE_BACK
results.comment: The sentinel appeared and the first Back hid the keyboard while retaining SearchActivity. The second Back was swallowed: SearchActivity remained visible with zznavbackqx, and search_card was absent.
